scope.supersedes_only: The Cycle-1 cycle_relation rule that exact or locked-p100 scientific RESEARCH_NO_GO prohibits every Cycle-2 experiment.
scope.new_rule: Exactly one final Cycle-2 branch is selected by the already defined terminal Cycle-1 scientific label: retain the existing matched incremental meta confirmation after complete RESEARCH_GO; use the fixed orthogonal raw-Celsius group-balanced residual branch after scientific RESEARCH_NO_GO.

frozen_cycle1_binding.verification_rule: Before any Cycle-1 or Cycle-2 authorization, recompute every listed raw and canonical hash; fail closed on any mismatch.

cycle1_terminal_scientific_RESEARCH_NO_G.eligible_when: The exact gate fails scientifically, or exact passes and locked-p100 fails scientifically, with all reached gates and integrity checks evaluated.

exactly_one_cycle2_router.branch_exclusivity: Exactly one branch may ever claim a Cycle-2 namespace. Either branch is P2_CYCLE_2_OF_EXACTLY_2_FINAL and terminates P2 research regardless of outcome.

orthogonal_failure_branch_cycle2.orthogonality: Cycle 1 is a fitted-model-free DTW trajectory retrieval and historical residual transfer. This branch performs no trajectory matching and instead fits one fixed public-feature LightGBM directly to raw-Celsius interpolation residual under deterministic layer-window-day weights.
orthogonal_failure_branch_cycle2.hypothesis: The historical public-layer feature signal may be usable when optimized in official raw-Celsius units with exact layer-window-day risk balance, even if shape retrieval cannot identify trustworthy target-layer neighbors.

frozen_facts: Pointwise and whole-day analog families were terminally rejected across blocks and layers.
The raw-Celsius group-balanced design remained conditional and has no completed result artifact.
This branch avoids both trajectory retrieval and normalized-curvature target scaling.

fixed_data_features_target_and_splits.feature_columns_source: Exact ordered /feature_contract/allowed_feature_columns array in the pinned historical seed design.
fixed_data_features_target_and_splits.target: target_temperature_c minus contemporaneous leakage-safe nearest-public-depth linear interpolation, in raw degrees Celsius
fixed_data_features_target_and_splits.historical_training_windows_source: Exact /fixed_historical_training_windows array in the pinned historical seed design.
fixed_data_features_target_and_splits.training_cutoff: 2024-08-25T00:00:00+09:00 exclusive; the same frozen training population is used for exact and locked-p100 inference.

locked_p100_surface.access: Do not open, stat-hash, hash, or parse until the branch's exact meaningful gate passes durably.

fixed_model_objective_and_search.group_weights: Exact full equalization over target layer, the four pinned historical windows, KST day, and rows within layer-window-day, as defined in /group_balanced_celsius_objective of the pinned historical seed design.
fixed_model_objective_and_search.ensemble: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the three decoded raw-Celsius predictions.

single_use_evaluation.exact_comparator: Frozen exact incumbent on the same independently verified 26273 keys and truth rows.
single_use_evaluation.p100_comparator: Frozen locked-p100 incumbent on the same independently verified 78156 keys and truth rows.
single_use_evaluation.procedure: Score exact once. Only after durable exact pass, apply the already fitted three-seed ensemble without refit to all locked-p100 folds and score once. No surface selects any parameter.

fixed_meaningful_gates.interpretation: Equal to or stricter than the frozen Cycle-1 SUBMISSION_GO exact and locked-p100 effect thresholds; pass remains local-only and is not submission authorization.
